patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a large 3D polygonal graphic on one side and prominent text on the other, creating a dynamic visual balance.
Sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll.
The main navigation bar transitions from transparent to a solid white background with a subtle shadow and sticks to the top of the viewport after initial scroll.
The hero's large polygonal pig graphic exhibits a subtle parallax effect and slight scaling as the user scrolls down, creating depth.
Strategic use of a vibrant green as a primary accent color for CTAs, links, and key headings, contrasting with a largely neutral background palette.
Headings use a bold, modern sans-serif font in varying sizes, with key phrases in the hero section being significantly larger and colored green for emphasis.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations reveal content sections by fading them up into view as they become visible in the viewport.
The main navigation bar uses a sticky position, dynamically changing its background from transparent to opaque white and adding a subtle drop shadow once the user scrolls past the hero section.
The hero's large 3D polygonal graphic is rendered using a canvas element, allowing for subtle parallax and scaling effects synchronized with scroll depth, creating an illusion of depth and movement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful headings (~3-4x body) with a modern sans-serif character, complemented by smaller, highly legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, with most other elements featuring sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous spacing in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a balanced density within content blocks like news cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a large, stylized 3D polygonal pig graphic in the hero section, rendered via canvas, immediately sets it apart. This playful yet sophisticated visual element, combined with the clean typography and scroll-triggered animations, creates a memorable and unique brand identity for an unexpected industry.
